children: Sanjeev Mehra takes on the expanded role after three decades in pharma, spanning business, strategy, patient centricity and people leadership
Eris Lifesciences has elevated Sanjeev Mehra to Vice President, Human Resources & Organisation Development, expanding his leadership role within the pharmaceutical company.

Mehra brings around three decades of experience in the pharmaceutical industry, having worked across business, strategy, patient centricity and people leadership. He has held leadership roles at organisations including Eli Lilly and AstraZeneca before joining Eris Lifesciences.

He has been associated with Eris in senior business and people leadership roles, most recently serving as General Manager, Human Resources & Training. His experience spans people development, business strategy, patient centricity and capability building.

In his expanded role, Mehra will focus on strengthening organisational capabilities, developing future leaders and embedding learning and development into everyday work. He is also expected to support a workplace culture centred on ownership, respect and long term career development.
Mehra said the new responsibility brings together his focus on understanding business, developing people and helping teams realise their potential.
